question: Judo had its origin in the ancient ____ art.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japanese**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Judo** originated in **Japan** and is deeply rooted in the traditional martial art of **Jujutsu**.
 
• The martial art of Judo was founded in **1882** by **Jigoro Kano**, who adapted Jujutsu techniques to develop a modern sport that emphasized skill and control over brute force.
 
• Judo translates to **"the gentle way"** in Japanese, reflecting its principle of using an opponent&
